svg.title: One invoice run, with every Week 1 control attached at the point it acts
svg.desc: Five steps run left to right: intake, read and reconcile, draft the record, approval pause, and write to the system of record. A dashed vertical line labelled the reversibility boundary sits between the approval pause and the write, so the first four steps are reversible and only the write is not. The approval pause is highlighted because it straddles that line. Two controls span the whole run: Day 1's max-step cap, counted in passes, and Day 5's trace, which records every step as a span. Two controls attach to single steps: Day 2's response budget with Day 4's compaction trigger, counted in tokens, attaches to the read and draft steps; Day 3's action gate and action budget, counted in writes, attaches to the write step.
